title: Adjuster Extensions of Work Conditioning and Work Hardening — Workers' Compensation Referral
content:
# Adjuster extensions of Work Conditioning and Work Hardening

**Recording rule.** An adjuster extending an hour-billed program of the Workers' Compensation Referral (Work Conditioning or Work Hardening) records the extension in person on the referral with the adjuster's own authorization reference and the first and last dates it covers, authorizing the requested program days at the requested weekly frequency; the referral's authorization reference, end date and weekly frequency then follow that extension. An extension is not recorded until the referral carries a program-hours charge for every program day the worker attended in the appointment series funded by the referral.

Restated: so long as any program day the worker attended in the Appointment Series funded by the referral has no program-hours charge on the referral, the extension is not recorded.

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Who records it | the adjuster, in person, on the referral |
| Reference | the adjuster's own authorization reference |
| Dates | the first and last dates the extension covers |
| What it authorizes | the requested program days, at the requested weekly frequency |
| After recording | the referral's authorization reference, end date and weekly frequency follow the extension |

## The adjuster's recording tool: `record_program_extension_8df51c57`

**Capability.** The claims adjuster records, in person, an extension of an hour-billed program: the adjuster's own authorization of further program days on the referral. One call adds one adjuster authorization to the referral's history with its reference, the program days and weekly frequency authorized and the first and last dates it covers. The referral's authorization in force becomes this one (reference, end date and weekly frequency), and its count of authorized program days still unused rises by the days authorized.

**Invocation.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `record_program_extension_8df51c57` and hands it over; the customer themselves — the claims adjuster on the line — runs it in person.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `wc_case_id` | the reference number of the referral being extended, read out to the adjuster by the clinic from the referral lookup | identifier |
| `auth_reference` | the adjuster's own authorization reference for this extension | exactly as the adjuster states it, character for character, letters, digits and punctuation unchanged |
| `visits` | the program days authorized by this extension | non-negative whole number; no fractions and no empty value |
| `visits_per_week` | the program days per Monday-to-Sunday week the extension allows | non-negative whole number; no fractions and no empty value |
| `auth_start_date` | the first date of service the extension covers | YYYY-MM-DD; no empty value |
| `auth_end_date` | the last date of service the extension covers | YYYY-MM-DD; no empty value |

**Return.** On success the result reads `status` "authorized", with `wc_event_id` (the reference number of the new authorization entry), `wc_case_id`, `auth_reference`, `visits`, `visits_per_week`, `auth_start_date`, `auth_end_date` and `authorized_visits_remaining` (the authorized program days unused on the referral after the extension). The adjuster then sees the new authorization in force on the referral.
